positions.locationName: San Mateo, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Head of Technology
positions.description:
Led 15+ engineers across Backend, Client, and Machine Learning teams to develop products for English learners.

Technical Leadership
• Built a scalable, extensible and reliable infrastructure.
• Created the foundation for innovation improving developer experience.
• Defined and executed technical roadmaps, working closely with stakeholders.

Security & Privacy
• Designed and implemented infrastructure and product changes for security and privacy.
• Drove company-wide security and privacy initiatives.

Cross-Functional Leadership
• Increased visibility of planning and execution across the company by leveraging Jira and Notion.
• Introduced cross-functional on-call system, improving response times and user satisfaction.
• Led resource allocation and capacity planning across multiple products, working closely with product managers and stakeholders.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
• Developed and executed the technical roadmap to migrate video solutions from Zoom to Amazon Chime, collaborating closely with the product manager and Amazon.
• Conducted an in-depth review of backend systems and infrastructure, defining key milestones to drive scalability and technical improvements.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led foundational efforts to automate cost allocation and billing in shared kitchen facilities.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Played a key role in transforming the Korea engineering team for long-term success with the global organization.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Spearheaded architecture and data flow enhancements for system performance, scalability, and security.

• Collaborated with tech leads, product teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Created and executed the technical roadmap, working cross-functionally with internal and external teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the team in transforming team capabilities and system architecture

• Transitioned the team to Elixir, improving system performance and reliability.
• Migrated internal and external services to ensure full GDPR compliance.
• Automated provisioning of IBM Aspera on Cloud instances for IBM Cloud using the Open Service Broker API and Saga pattern.
• Improved system observability with Elasticsearch, Kibana, and New Relic.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed systems to support business processes such as licensing, usage metering, order processing, and subscription management.

• Led the full software development lifecycle for business process automation and integration.
• Championed the adoption of DevOps practices and tools, transforming the development workflow across the team and the wider organization prior to Aspera's acquisition by IBM.
• Built a scalable foundation for ongoing improvements.

projects.title: Grepvine
projects.description:
As part of Master’s final team project, we developed a tool designed to help users discover more meaningful discussions across the web.

• Built the backend system to collect, process, and analyze web pages, and then serves APIs for a Chrome extension developed by a teammate.
• Analyzed data using R and visualized insights with ggplot2 to enhance the quality of discussions surfaced

Technologies used: Python, Django, MongoDB, Solr, R, ggplot2

projects.title: PubMed Cat
projects.description:
Developed a web platform for researchers to efficiently organize and manage PubMed papers. This tool was instrumental in supporting the research for the publication:

Kim, J., Jung, H., & Bates, D. W. (2011). History and Trends of “Personal Health Record” Research in PubMed. Healthcare Informatics Research, 17(1), 3–17. http://doi.org/10.4258/hir.2011.17.1.3

Technologies used: Ruby on Rails, MySQL

publications.title: A Comparison of Ontology Reasoning Systems Using Query Sequences
publications.publisher: ICUIMC '08 Proceedings of the 2nd international conference on Ubiquitous information management and communication · Jan 1, 2008
